title.en: Two notes about the school garden

en: Note A — from the garden club: “Our club grew 40 kilograms of vegetables this term. Students who worked in the garden learned to measure plant growth and keep records. We ask the school to double the garden’s size next year.”

Note B — from the sports teacher: “The garden is a good project, but it already uses part of the field. If it doubles, two classes will lose their outdoor game space. Perhaps the garden could grow upwards, using shelves on the wall.”
Both notes agree that the garden helps students learn. They disagree about how it should grow.
id: Catatan A — dari klub berkebun: “Klub kami memanen 40 kilogram sayur semester ini. Siswa yang bekerja di kebun belajar mengukur pertumbuhan tanaman dan mencatat data. Kami meminta sekolah menggandakan luas kebun tahun depan.”

Catatan B — dari guru olahraga: “Kebun adalah proyek yang baik, tetapi sudah memakai sebagian lapangan. Jika luasnya digandakan, dua kelas akan kehilangan tempat bermain di luar. Mungkin kebun bisa tumbuh ke atas, memakai rak di dinding.”
Kedua catatan sepakat bahwa kebun membantu siswa belajar. Keduanya berbeda pendapat tentang cara kebun itu berkembang.

prompt.en: What do both notes agree on?

en: The field is too small for games.

prompt.en: Which detail does the garden club use to support its request?
prompt.id: Rincian apa yang dipakai klub berkebun untuk mendukung permintaannya?

en: Shelves can go on the wall.

prompt.en: Why does the sports teacher suggest shelves?

en: to keep the garden and the play space
because shelves are cheaper than seeds
